testcase.name: Radius accuracy relative to S near an end: very different radii and t close to the end with the small radius (contract 5, radius rule)
Derivatives agree with central finite differences, including extrapolated t (section 5)
A1: near-seam offsets (-2^-60, +-MIN_VALUE, 1 - 2^-53, ...) match the exact small-angle values within the section 7.2 bound
Factories: circle, arc, helix, planar and conical spirals, and the M1 horizontal circle factories (section 5)
Helix and spirals: radius interpolates exactly at the ends; height is rise * t; helix speed is constant sqrt((2 pi r turns)^2 + rise^2) (section 5)
Large turn counts: quarter phases stay exact after 2^20 turns, where a radian implementation is off by about 1e-9 (section 5, DM3-6)
M1 CONVENTIONS 5: starting at +X with normal +Y, counter-clockwise from above reaches -Z at +90 degrees, clockwise reaches +Z (exact)
Validation: radii finite and >= 0; rise, turns, startTurn finite; parameters finite (sections 5, 8)
T4: seams are exact for every integer t (up to 2^60) and every startTurn magnitude (section 5)
Full Heal ring (r cos th, 0, r sin th) is horizontalClockwiseFromAbove; Astral Prism's +Y rotation is horizontalCounterClockwiseFromAbove (M1 CONVENTIONS 2, 5)
Exact quarter-turn points for any radius and start phase that land on quarter turns (section 5)
A1 / T5: for non-negative startTurn the result depends only on startTurn mod 1, bitwise; negative offsets agree within the bound
A2: extrapolated radius cancellation; the error is bounded relative to S = |1-t| r0 + |t| r1, not to r(t) (review counterexample: exact radius 2^-52)
A1 / T3: quarter-turn phases are exact for startTurn of any magnitude (2^52, -2^52, 2^53, 2^60, +-MAX_VALUE, 2^50 + 1/4, ...) and for negative offsets
Seams: a closed spiral (equal radii, no rise, integer non-zero turns) has point(k) == point(0) and derivative(k) == derivative(0) exactly for integer k (section 5)
